Paper Name: Techno-Economic Analysis of Hybrid Hydrogen Fuel-Cell/PV/Wind turbine/Battery/Diesel Energy System for Rural Coastal Community in Western Australia (Al-Hanahi et al., 2023, i-COSTE)
NOTES: Optimal Fuel cell/PV/Wind/DG/Battery HRES (Case 1) selected as primary configuration per the paper's stated 'optimal off-grid design'. Daily load 1441 kWh/day x 365 = 525,965 kWh/year inferred as annual load (paper does not explicitly state annual load). LCOE=0.5238 $/kWh from Table VII. LPSP not explicitly stated in paper. H2_LHV not reported. Diesel constants f_0, f_1 not reported. Emission factors e_FC, e_DG, e_EL not reported. Discount/interest rate r not explicitly stated. Project lifetime not explicitly stated in the results tables. The paper uses HOMER Pro simulation. NOx emissions for optimal HRES = 331 kg/year (Table IX). PV capital and replacement cost are identical at $1,575,000 each; O&M is $625 total (not per kW). Battery capacity given as 224 strings with throughput 800 kWh; nominal capacity per string not stated. Electrolyser O&M $450 is total system O&M (assumed). Fuel cell O&M $17,520 is total system O&M (assumed). Some O&M costs are total system costs not per-unit costs. Converter capacity is 98.4 kW. Wind turbine capacity 230 kW (single turbine). The paper states derating factor of 80% for PV and module lifetime 25 years in text (contradicts Table I which says 20 years lifetime) — using Table lifetime of 20 years for life_PV as it's the formal table value. WT lifetime not stated.
